accounting_policy.bad_debt: Writeoff at simulated payment default, no earlier than warranty end; invoices beyond cutoff retain receivable and explicit pending outcome. Known exogenous default draws are hidden from the decision policy until payment due. No present-value or credit allowance is claimed.
accounting_policy.funding: Actual campaign investment gate allows earned-profit funding only, requiring cumulative profit and collected unrestricted cash surplus above original equity, after liabilities and reserves. This is more conservative than permitting pre-payback capital investment. Fixtures can test separately declared capital-funded policies without changing campaign.
accounting_policy.payback: Cash project return equals attributable collections minus all development/investment/delivery cost payments and refunds; opening equity is excluded. Positive accounting profit is separate.
accounting_policy.recognition: Revenue after actual artifact acceptance and contractual delivery; collection is separate. Development and investment expensed once at incurred modeled resource amount; payments do not expense again. Costs incurred without cash remain payable.
accounting_policy.warranty: Revenue reversal reduces outstanding receivable first; only collected portion creates refund payable. Refund reduces cash and liability, not expense again.

boundaries: All buyers, contracts, prices, invoices, financing, revenue, payments and defaults are simulated. Every production attempt that reaches artifact construction executes catalog code and an independent checker. A supplier outage before artifact production is simulated and marked. Actual complete AI cost is unknown; modeled normalized resource charges are separate.

commercial_qualification.scope: Each predeclared scenario separately; conditional commercial GO requires >=80% sampled full-project profits positive, no incurred unpaid liability and every world's unrestricted cash>=25, with no world's full-project loss exceeding USD25. Report min profit/downside, receivables and acceptance. Failure in adverse scenarios does not erase reference-scenario profitability. This is not observed demand.

complete_resource_recost_sensitivity.purpose: Unknown actual model usage and rates remain unknown; normalized base scenario is not an actual profit estimate.
complete_resource_recost_sensitivity.scope: Every resource accrue_cost including initial development, failed discovery, construction, acquisition, production, independent checks, support, maintenance and storage. Static recost of frozen accepted outcomes and actions; no policy rerun or extra capital, liquidity NOT thereby established. Baddebt/revenue reversals unchanged.

1.capability: Composite-key catalogs with duplicate SKU across locales; same SKU rows no longer collapse.

2.capability: Explicit supplier header aliases and decimal equivalence, preserving existing numeric formatting on equal value.

3.capability: Selective field updates preserve local notes while external row membership remains authoritative.

cutoff_policy: Trading periods start0,60,120,240 and last60days each. Original three-period reference closes at240 unchanged; bounded amended fourth period trades241..295 and closes360, retaining net75 invoices beyondcutoff. No forced collection or outcome-dependent extension beyond this one predeclared amendment.

acquisition_policy.basis: Automated discovery, pricing training and private simulated buyer workflow; no real outreach; bounded estimate.

base_engineering.basis: One base instrument, CLI and tests with two repair rounds; bounded consumption estimate, not metered.

failed_discovery_and_canon.basis: Three candidate probes and source reading: bounded AI-native consumption estimate, including failures; not metered.

independent_verification.basis: Separate checker, controls and accounting reconstruction; bounded estimate, not metered.

packaging_installation_publication_revie.basis: Source, EN/FR interface, installation, replay and handoff; bounded estimate, no real paid commitment.

flywheel_qualification.comparison: Paired profit and accepted outcomes against no investment; competent conventional and ordinary-library sameartifact comparisons reported separately, parity denies exclusive successor advantage.
flywheel_qualification.exercising_definition: After a funded generationN construction, accepted commercial request must actually require featureN; running newsource on earlier basic work is insufficient. Report occurrence fraction, not prescribed result.

fresh_assessment.claim_limits: Independent worlds estimate model sampling variability, not structural-model calibration; no confidence interval cures uncertain demand or strategic rules.
fresh_assessment.generations: Up to3 actual constructed improvements available; economic worlds simulate adaptation/funding of executed assets, not fresh code invention. Reference stages actual construction only after earned collection.
fresh_assessment.horizon: Four60day trading periods with starts0,60,120,240; final60day runoff to360. Gap180..240 settles early obligations; late receivables explicitly retained.
fresh_assessment.seeds: Independent verifier generates after source/policy/protocol freeze; no result-dependent stopping or retuning.

free_alternatives: CSV replace plus original snapshot rollback
human_market.frontier_alternative: Direct frontier AI plus independent buyer checking; consumption$0.04 and0.12-0.55 buyer-hours are uncertain assumptions. No production AI reliability is inferred from announcements.
human_market.hours_basis: Unmeasured equivalent task-hour assumption for matched catalog comparison, patch review and rollback; not claimed observed or experimentally established. Value gap H-C is not revenue.

reference_seed_basis: Date-derived before the first reference world, not selected from results.

resource_rates.compute_basis: Explicit price assumption; quantity includes deterministic tooling, independent checks, development retries and packaging. Sensitivity supplier disruption4x, punitive cost100x; actual host invoices unknown.
resource_rates.cost_sensitivity: Scenarios include4x supplier charges and100x all per-delivery charges; development/scoped construction are separately inspectable. Unknown actual usage does not become actual zero.
resource_rates.data_tools_infrastructure: Synthetic generated data and stdlib local files: zero incremental license/API expense by construction; tools/verification/maintenance consume the separately estimated model and compute units. No monthly allowance or human labor rate is charged.
resource_rates.delivery_model_boundary: Actual catalog production invokes Python transformation and independent checker locally, no providerAPIcall and no computer-use actions. Perorder token allocations are a conservative hypothetical autonomous orchestration scenario, not measured inference; actual calls0. CPU ns and file bytes measured separately.
resource_rates.model_rate_scope: Published Terra rates $1/M input and $5/M output are a normalized counterfactual consumption scenario, not a claim that this session used that model, had that API access or incurred that bill. No paid provider call is made by campaign code.
resource_rates.storage_quantity: Measured per-artifact input+output bytes × remaining days todeclaredcutoff, rounded upward to integer MiB-days;1microUSD/MiB-day (USD0.03072/GiB-30days) explicit modeled rate. Nonartifact journal/state/summary bytes charged separately once at cutoff fordeclaredhorizon days conservative retention. No double charge of artifact bytes. Actual host invoices unknown.

strategic_model.buyers: Observe price, declared features, measured deterministic artifact acceptance and offered alternatives; minimize all-in disutility including their uncertain participation effort, delay and expected error loss. Can decline, negotiate, default, claim warranty or switch. No-purchase pays forgone value, not enterprise revenue.
strategic_model.competitors: Start with heterogeneous supplied quality/price, adopt same AI each period, improve quality and lower price in response to observed enterprise share down to their stated floor. These response rules are scenario assumptions, not calibrated equilibrium.
strategic_model.default_incentive: Reference collection-compliance is assumed, not an equilibrium theorem. Strategic-default stress gives buyers a high chance to withhold payment after receiving the artifact; warranty and normal costs still remain. Strongest pure-payment deviation can destroy enterprise viability and is reported separately.
strategic_model.equal_tool_parity: Adversarial same-artifact competitor at USD0.05, perfect modeled quality and zero switching cost; competent conventional participation effort0.02hours and direct AI0.01hours. Tests whether packaging supports a positive price once equivalent instruments are easily accessible.
strategic_model.online_policy: NPV forecasts use frozen requirement shares/choice probabilities; no refitting to final outcomes. Funding additionally requires cumulative profit, unrestricted cash above opening capital, reserve cover and the separately bounded HOLD-probe allowance.
strategic_model.suppliers: Finite period capacity, distinct outages and charge multipliers. New discretionary orders refuse if protected closeout capacity is threatened. Every failed attempt retains incurred costs.
